An exclusive loyalty app built for {{CLIENT}}. {{CLIENT}}'s staff, owner and our developers use one app. Guests install nothing: they scan a QR code, enter their details, agree to the terms, and receive a digital card in their phone's wallet that shows their points.

How it works for a guest

  • The guest scans the QR code, enters their name and phone or email, and agrees to the Terms & Conditions.
  • Their {{CLIENT}} card is added to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet and shows their points.
  • At the till, staff scan the QR on the card, confirm with a short changing code, and add points from the bill.

Terms common to all plans

  • Prices are in Bahraini dinars. VAT of 10% is added if applicable.
  • Billed monthly in advance. The minimum term is 12 months, then monthly.
  • There are no one-time charges. Design, branding, app and wallet setup and staff training are included in the monthly fee.
  • The Apple and Google accounts that publish the wallet cards are held by [CONFIRM: LOYALTY or the client].
  • Scanners that come with a plan are loaned for as long as you subscribe. They stay our property and are returned if the subscription ends. A lost or damaged device is replaced at cost.
  • Wallet notifications are sent only to guests who agreed, and guests can switch them off at any time.
